title: Cash Pickup Funding Collection, Rate Guarantee and Funding Cancellations
content:
**Treasury memo: funding and rate guarantee on Cash Pickup transfers.**

## When funds are collected

| Funding method | Funds collected |
|---|---|
| debit card, credit card, pay-by-bank | at booking |
| ACH debit | when the debit settles |
| wire | when the wire arrives |

## Rate guarantee

The quoted rate is guaranteed for the tier's rate-lock hours, counted as elapsed hours from the moment the transfer was booked.

A rate is re-quoted only when funds are collected more than the rate-lock hours after the transfer was booked. The lock hours are measured from the booking moment to the moment the funds are collected. The comparison is strict: funds collected exactly at the end of the lock are not re-quoted.

A re-quote has these terms:
- it uses the rate sheet for the collection date, with the same margin rule;
- it re-discloses the exchange rate, the cash amount and the date of availability;
- it never changes fees;
- a US-dollar payout is never re-quoted.

### Boundary cases (hypothetical 48-hour lock, booked Monday 09:00)

| Funds collected | Elapsed hours | Re-quote |
|---|---|---|
| Wednesday 08:59 | 47 h 59 min | no |
| Wednesday 09:00 | exactly 48 | no |
| Wednesday 09:01 | 48 h 1 min | yes |

## Cancellations for funding

- On a tier whose wire deadline is above 0 hours, Paloma cancels a wire-funded booking whose funds have not arrived by the booking moment plus the deadline hours, counted as elapsed hours.
- When an ACH debit is returned unpaid before release, or a card capture fails, Paloma cancels the transfer and records the reason as a failed funding.
- Nothing is owed back on a cancellation for missing or failed funding, and the Cash Pickup transfer stays cancelled.

All evidence for these judgements is the system's record of the booking moment and the collection moment, not the customer's recollection.
